quote: Prompt the LLM to summarize every social message

To take advantage of the ability of LLMs to summarize, complete abbreviations, and provide additional context, we design and test a series of prompts... "Summarize the following sentences: <Input text>. If you come across some abbreviations, expand them. Please respond in English".

LSED applies three state-of-the-art open-source LLMs through OLLama : Meta's Llama3.1-8B (Llama Team, 2024), Alibaba's Qwen2.5-7B , and Google's Gemma2-9B (Gemma Team, 2024)... 'Summarize the following sentences:<Input text>. If you come across some abbreviations, expand them. Please respond in English'
outputs: summarized social messages with expanded abbreviations and translated into English
